summary: Phase A — Devis multi-plans CONSOLIDÉ éditable — E2E frontend flow fully validated. Login Pro → open plan (?open=plan_e11c525fa9fb) → click plan-multi-quote-btn → multi-quote-dialog opens → checked plan_e11c525fa9fb, plan_60e79f8b1087, plan_3a5b25eb5bcf → checked multi-subcontract-plan_60e79f8b1087 → clicked multi-consolidated-btn (label 'Devis consolidé (3)') → POST /api/documents/from-plans returned 200 → navigated to /devis-editeur/doc_xxx. Verified generated doc has 11 lines with expected VAT distribution: 4 lines @10% (maison plan_e11c525fa9fb), 4 lines @0% (sous-traitance plan_60e79f8b1087, e.g. Plâtrerie/Placo, Peinture, Sol Carrelage, Plinthes), 3 lines @20% (ferraillage: Acier HA12, Acier HA8, Treillis soudé ST25). Categories are prefixed by plan type/name: 'Maison · tp.png · Depuis plan IA' and 'Ferraillage · tp.png · Ferraillage'. In the editor: line-level VAT <select> exposes options ['0 %','5.5%','10%','20%'] and bulk-vat-select exposes ['Appliquer…','0 % (sous-traitance)','5.5%','10%','20%']. Totals rendered: TVA 0% 0,00€ (base sub-traitance 6591€), TVA 10% 699,13€, TVA 20% 117,82€, Total TTC 15 388,67€. No JS console errors, no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/documents/from-plans returns doc envelope with lines=[] initially in HTTP response body, but GET /api/documents/{id} returns full lines list. Frontend nav then re-fetches via GET so it works; however the endpoint's create-response payload is misleading — consider returning the persisted lines directly to save a round-trip.
Dialog lists ALL plans of the user (100 checkboxes here). For accounts with many plans a search/filter input in multi-quote-dialog would improve UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A frontend flow validated end-to-end. Plans page uses deep-link '/plan?open=<plan_id>' (not '?id='). Editor uses native <select> elements (not shadcn) for VAT — accessible via querySelectorAll('table select'). Bulk vat has data-testid='bulk-vat-select'; per-line selects don't have data-testid but are positioned after unit/price inputs. Consider adding data-testid='line-vat-<idx>' for future testing robustness.
